an8.24:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā āḷaviyaṃ viharati aggāḷave cetiye.
an8.24:1.2: atha kho hatthako āḷavako pañcamattehi upāsakasatehi parivuto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an8.24:1.4: kathaṃ pana tvaṃ hatthaka, imaṃ mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgaṇhāhīti?
an8.24:1.5: yānimāni bhante, bhagavatā desitāni cattāri saṅgahavatthūni tenāhaṃ imaṃ parisaṃ saṅgaṇhāmi.
an8.24:1.7: ‘ayaṃ dānena saṅgahetabbo’ ti, taṃ dānena saṅgaṇhāmi.
an8.24:1.14: saṃvijjanti kho pana me bhante, kule bhogā.
an8.24:1.15: daḷiddassa kho no tathā sotabbaṃ maññantīti,
an8.24:1.17: yoni kho tyāyaṃ hatthaka, mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgahetuṃ,
an8.24:1.18: ye hi keci hatthaka, atītamaddhānaṃ parisaṃ saṅgahesuṃ, sabbe te imeheva catuhi saṅgahavatthūhi mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgahesuṃ.
an8.24:1.19: yepi hi keci hatthaka, anāgatamaddhānaṃ mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgahessanti sabbe te imeheva catuhi saṅgahavatthūhi mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgahissanti.
an8.24:1.20: yepi hi keci hatthaka, etarahi mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgaṇhanni sabbe te imeheva catuhi saṅgahavatthūhi mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgaṇhantīti.
an8.24:2.1: atha kho hatthako āḷavako bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an8.24:2.2: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkante hatthake āḷavake bhikkhu āmantesi:
an8.24:2.3: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ dhāretha,
an8.24:2.13: imehi kho bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ dhārethāti.
